car_input.camera: VISION_STREAM_ROAD (the narrow road camera), the whole frame: 1344 x 760 on the comma 4, as the frames of the dataset (frames.jsonl width 1344, height 760, camera_stream narrow_road)
car_input.decode: road_type = classes[argmax(probabilities)], classes exactly road_types.ROAD_TYPES (town, rural, expressway, motorway, ramp, parking); feed SpeedLimitMemory.update(road_type=...) only after the same class 3 steps in a row (the measure's debounce). "ramp" is an on- or off-ramp: ramp then motorway or expressway is the merge, where the ramp's limit ends without a sign
car_input.junction_decode: passed = junction[0, 1]; an intersection is passed when passed >= 0.5 and the previous step was below; at most one event in 3 s. A false "passed" lifts the limit of a sign (Poland: a sign holds to the next intersection): use it only where the law says so, never in place of a sign that ends a limit

cereal.yaw: livePose.angularVelocityDevice.z (rad/s, device frame, z down: yaw = -z) and .valid; this sunnypilot names the service deviceMotion; fallback carState.yawRate (rad/s, left positive)

motion.never: a map field: the vision side reads the camera and the car only

car_input.rate: one step a second (the training frames are 1 s apart; 2 Hz would make its memory twice as fast: keep 1 Hz)
steps: y, uv = vision.nv12_planes(buf.data, buf.width, buf.height, buf.stride, buf.uv_offset)
planes = vision.yuv_to_rgb(y, uv, 0, buf.height, 0, buf.width)  # uint8 (3, 760, 1344), ffmpeg BT.601 limited range, as the dataset PNGs
planes = vision.resize(planes, 256, 144)  # PIL BILINEAR (antialiased), columns then rows: bit-exact with the training cache (road_type_data.resized_frame)
image = planes[None].astype(np.float32) / 255.0  # (1, 3, 144, 256) RGB 0..1, NCHW: no mean/std, the network normalises inside

age = now - memory._road_sign_at  # speedvisiond's SpeedLimitMemory: when it last confirmed other_sign:motorway_start or expressway_start (read 5 times a second, MIN_CONFIDENCE, CONFIRM_FRAMES within CONFIRM_SECONDS); -inf before the first: age inf
Subscribe to livePose (named deviceMotion in this sunnypilot, 20 Hz) and carState (100 Hz); at each step t take the samples of the last second (t - 1 s, t]

yaw: the samples with angularVelocityDevice.valid; at least 10 of them: yaw_dps = mean(-degrees(angularVelocityDevice.z)) (the device z points down; left positive, the heading change of the step in degrees), yaw_max = max(|degrees(z)|); fewer: from carState.yawRate (rad/s, left positive) the same way when the car fills it (not always 0); else unknown

steer = mean(carState.steeringAngleDeg) over the step (left positive); left / right = carState.leftBlinker / rightBlinker true at any sample of the last 2 s; with fewer than 10 carState samples in the step all of these are unknown

motion = [[clip(yaw_dps / 30, -3, 3), clip(yaw_max / 30, 0, 3), 1, clip(steer / 180, -4, 4), 1, left, right, 1]]  # car_motion.motion_features; an unknown part is all zeros, its known flag 0 (yaw: 0..2, steer: 3..4, blinkers: 5..7). Never a map field: the car's own signals only
hidden = zeros((1, 128), float32) at the start of the drive (and after more than 5 s without a step); then the hidden_out of the previous step; junction_hidden the same with junction_hidden_out
probabilities, hidden, junction, junction_hidden = session.run(None, {"image": image, "speed": speed, "sign": sign, "motion": motion, "hidden": hidden, "junction_hidden": junction_hidden})

input.name: image
input.normalization: none: ImageNet mean and std are applied inside the network
input.source: narrow road camera NV12 -> vision.yuv_to_rgb -> vision.resize

meaning: 1 when the speed is known, else 0 (and the first value 0)
inputs.name: speed

meaning: min(age, 120) / 60: age = seconds since SpeedLimitMemory last confirmed a motorway or expressway sign (now - _road_sign_at)
1 when that is at most 120 s ago, else 0; never or longer ago: [2.0, 0.0]
inputs.name: sign

meaning: heading change of the last second: mean yaw rate deg/s (left positive) / 30, clipped to +-3
largest |yaw rate| in it deg/s / 30, clipped to 0..3
1 when the yaw is known (livePose valid, else carState.yawRate), else 0 (and both values 0)
mean carState.steeringAngleDeg of the last second / 180, clipped to +-4 (left positive)
1 when carState is known, else 0 (and the steering 0)
1 when carState.leftBlinker was on in the last 2 s
1 when carState.rightBlinker was on in the last 2 s
1 when carState is known (the blinkers), else 0
inputs.name: motion

inputs.meaning: the memory: zeros at the start, then the previous step's hidden_out
inputs.name: hidden

inputs.meaning: the junction head's own memory: zeros at the start, then the previous step's junction_hidden_out
inputs.name: junction_hidden

output.decode: softmax probabilities; the class is the argmax
output.name: probabilities

outputs.meaning: give it back as hidden at the next step
outputs.name: hidden_out

outputs.decode: passed = junction[0, 1]; an intersection is passed when passed >= 0.5 and the previous step was below; at most one event in 3 s. A false "passed" lifts the limit of a sign (Poland: a sign holds to the next intersection): use it only where the law says so, never in place of a sign that ends a limit
meaning: the probability that the car is inside an intersection of public roads (sigmoid)
the probability that it has just left one: the first second after it (sigmoid)
outputs.name: junction

outputs.meaning: give it back as junction_hidden at the next step
outputs.name: junction_hidden_out
